active.description: Whether the token is currently active, per the [introspection response](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7662#section-2.2). `false` stands alone.

scope.description: Space-separated [scope](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-3.3) values granted to the token.

client_id.description: The [`client_id`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-2.2) the token was issued to.

iat.description: The [`iat`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.6) claim: issue time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

exp.description: The [`exp`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.4) claim: expiry, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Present for tokens that expire.

iss.description: The [`iss`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.1) claim: the authorization server that issued the token.

aud.description: The [`aud`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.3) claim: the protected resource the token was issued for. Present for resource-bound tokens.

sub.description: The [`sub`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.2) claim: the subject the token was issued for.
